introduction.label: OUR APPROACH
introduction.heading: Different Industries. Different Priorities. One Connected Approach.

paragraphs.body: Every industry has its own customers, workflows, regulations, sales cycles, and competitive pressures. A digital solution that works well for an online retailer may not suit a healthcare provider, construction company, legal practice, energy business, or local service organization.

CODEYEA begins by understanding how the business operates, how customers make decisions, where teams lose time, and which digital systems already support the work. We then connect the right combination of strategy, design, development, eCommerce, SEO, automation, hosting, and technical support around those realities.

The industries below represent areas where focused digital execution can improve visibility, communication, lead generation, customer experience, and everyday operations. Each solution is adapted to the organization instead of forcing every business into the same platform or process.

items.body:
Websites and online systems need ongoing attention. Plugins update, integrations fail, pages slow down, forms stop sending, and hosting problems can interrupt everyday work. CODEYEA provides practical technical support to investigate, fix, maintain and explain what is happening.

- WordPress troubleshooting, plugin and theme issues
- Website maintenance and performance optimization
- Hosting, DNS, SSL and email configuration
- Form and integration fixes
- Migration, backup and restore assistance

We review the issue and access requirements, reproduce or diagnose the problem, and back up before making changes. After applying and testing the fix, we explain what changed and recommend preventive maintenance where useful. Send us the problem, what changed recently and any error message you have; that gives us a practical place to start.
items.title: Technical support for the work ahead.

items.body:
Branding is more than a logo. It is the visual language people associate with your business, from the website and social profiles to proposals, printed material and digital products. We help create or refine that identity so the business feels consistent wherever customers meet it.

- Logo, colour and typography systems
- Website and app interface design
- Social media and campaign assets
- Brochures, company profiles and presentations

We begin by understanding the business and audience, reviewing the existing identity and defining a visual direction. The system is then applied to real use cases, with organized files and guidelines your team can reuse. If your business has outgrown its current look, we can make it feel more intentional while preserving what already works.
items.title: Give your brand a voice of its own.

items.body:

Work can include WooCommerce stores or Shopify setup and customization, product catalog structure, checkout and payment integrations, shipping connections, and inventory and order workflows. Product filtering, search and analytics help teams understand how customers find products and complete a purchase.

We plan the store and navigation, develop the experience, configure payment and shipping, and test the full purchase journey before handover. Whether you are launching your first store or improving an existing one, the goal is a shopping experience that works for both customers and staff.
